summary.intent: Fix two CI failures: intermittent E2E test failures in full-workflow and sharing-workflow specs, and a Grafana Cloud provisioning failure in the staging pipeline.
summary.outcome: The E2E race condition in FileList.tsx was fixed and verified locally (both originally-failing tests now pass), a PR was opened and review comments addressed. The Grafana issue was diagnosed as a configuration problem requiring manual action.

repo: The web app's Vite dev server proxies /api to localhost:3000 by default; VITE_API_URL must be set to point at staging API for local-vs-staging testing.

Web3Auth initialization fails when the web app origin doesn't match the configured allowed origins — running web locally against staging API caused login failures until the env was properly configured.
API .env files live in apps/api and apps/web but are not committed; the worktree doesn't inherit them from the main repo checkout — must be copied manually.

The Grafana Cloud provisioning job fails because the stack URL (https://cipherbox.grafana.net) returns 404 — the instance may be deprovisioned or the slug is wrong; GRAFANA_URL in the GitHub staging environment needs updating.

code.finding: Original dedup filter removed real file rows when their name matched a completing upload entry during the 1-second green flash. Fixed by reversing the logic: filter out upload rows when real files with the same name exist, so real files are never transiently removed from the DOM.
After PR review, the name-based dedup filter was further improved to filter by upload ID instead of name, preventing false positives when multiple concurrent uploads share the same filename.

workflow: For web-only E2E fixes: run the web dev server locally with the fix applied, pointed at the staging API (VITE_API_URL=<staging>), then run Playwright tests against localhost:5173 — no local API needed.
Copying env files from the main repo checkout into the worktree is the fastest way to bootstrap a parallel worktree's local dev environment.

When a test passes locally but fails in CI, check whether the local setup is inconsistent (e.g., web pointed at staging API while a local API is also running), which can cause session/auth confusion in unrelated tests.

friction: Multiple failed attempts to run E2E tests before settling on the correct approach (local web + staging API): first tried staging-only, then full local stack, then realized web-only local was sufficient.
The worktree didn't have API or web .env files, requiring manual copy from the main repo — this blocked server startup and wasn't obvious upfront.
Port 3000 was already occupied by the main repo's API server, causing the worktree API server to exit immediately on startup.

Web3Auth fails to initialize when the app runs on localhost but is configured for a different origin, making it non-trivial to run the web app locally against the staging API without proper env config.
The user had to prompt Claude to actually run the E2E tests after the fix was implemented — Claude initially stopped at 'build succeeds' without verifying the fix end-to-end.
open_items: full-workflow test 17 ('Page reload preserves session') fails locally but was not investigated — suspected pre-existing auth session timeout issue, not related to the upload dedup fix.

Grafana Cloud provisioning requires manual action: verify the correct stack URL in the Grafana Cloud account and update GRAFANA_URL + GRAFANA_API_KEY in the GitHub staging environment. Consider adding continue-on-error: true to unblock staging deploys in the interim.
The correct E2E local dev setup (local web + staging API) and the env copy step from the main repo should be documented in the learnings doc to avoid repeating the same friction.
